why: A quote of zero reads as cheap. `note` is declared here and holds no instances, so every projection costs nothing — and a caller told only that has been handed the most affordable possible way to learn nothing. `absence` is carried for exactly that reason and follows `query`'s rules unchanged. The pack row is deliberately NOT zero: a pack over an empty answer carries the diagnosis, and that is the part worth paying for when there is no answer. A server returning `pack.chars: 0` here has produced a pack that says nothing about a corpus that has something to say.
